summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Kurye Yönetim Sistemi (Courier Management System). All core functionalities tested including registration, login, dashboard access, courier approval, admin management, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: API Health Check - All 20 backend endpoints working
Courier Registration - Form validation and name formatting works
Admin Dashboard - All tabs (Vardiya, Muhasebe, Zimmet, Kuryeler, Yoneticiler) accessible
Courier Approval/Rejection - Super admin can approve/reject couriers
Admin Management - Super admin can create new admins and manage permissions
Courier Dashboard - All tabs (Vardiya, Muhasebe, Zimmet) with placeholder content
Mobile Responsiveness - Login, dashboard, and navigation work on mobile/tablet
Name Capitalization - Names properly formatted (first letters capitalized)
Login System - Separate tabs for Kurye vs Yönetici login work correctly
Logout Functionality - Works on both desktop and mobile
Permission System - Yoneticiler tab only visible to super admin
